players.bio: Amar Sejdić (born November 29, 1996) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew. He played four years of college soccer for the Maryland Terrapins.

Anass Zaroury (born 7 November 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Greek Super League club Panathinaikos, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lens. Born in Belgium, he plays for the Morocco national team.

André Filipe Tavares Gomes (born 30 July 1993) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew. He played three years at Benfica, where he won the domestic treble in the 2013–14 season. In July 2014 he joined Valencia and, two years later, signed with Barcelona also in the Spanish La Liga.

Marcelo Andrés Herrera Mansilla (born 3 November 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew, on loan from River Plate. Herrera started his senior career with San Lorenzo, having had youth spells with Textil Mandiyú, Boca Unidos and Rivadavia.
Brais Méndez Portela (born 7 January 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for RC Celta de Vigo as an attacking midfielder.

Brooks Howard Lennon (born September 22, 1997) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger and full-back. As a teenager, Lennon played with the Real Salt Lake youth academy in Arizona. He signed with English team Liverpool in 2015, and joined their youth teams. On December 20, 2017, it was announced that Lennon would join Real Salt Lake on a permanent basis.

Cole Mrowka (born April 6, 2006) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew. Born in the United States, he plays for the Philippines national team.

Dániel Gazdag (Hborn 2 March 1996) is a Hungarian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for the Columbus Crew of Major League Soccer and the Hungary national team. Club career In May 2021, Gazdag was officially signed by the Philadelphia Union competing in Major League Soccer.

Dylan Chambost (born 19 August 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as midfielder for the Columbus Crew of Major League Soccer. Career A youth product of Saint-Étienne, on 1 July 2019 Chambost signed with Troyes AC. He made his professional debut for Troyes in a 2–1 Ligue 2 loss to Clermont Foot on 2 August 2019.

Eric Bertrand Bailly (born 12 April 1994) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew and the Ivory Coast national team. Although he mainly plays as a centre-back, he can also play as a right-back.Although he mainly plays as a centre-back, he can also play as a right-back.
Evan William Bush (born March 6, 1986) is an American soccer player, who plays as a goalkeeper for Columbus Crew in Major League Soccer.
Gonzalo Andrés Tapia Dubournais (born 18 February 2002) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División club River Plate and the Chile national team.

Henrik Per-Erik Rydström (born 16 February 1976) is a Swedish professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of MLS club Columbus Crew. As of 2013, he was the sixth longest serving player in the world when it comes to playing for the same club. He made his debut for Kalmar in 1994 and played his last game for the team in 2013.
Jamal Thiaré (born 31 March 1993) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew.

Josef Alexander Martínez Mencia (born 19 May 1993) is a Venezuelan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Liga MX club Tijuana and the Venezuela national team. Josef Martínez began his career with Caracas. In 2012, he was acquired by the Swiss Super League club Young Boys before spending a year on loan at Thun.
Malte Meineche Amundsen (born 11 February 1998) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Columbus Crew of Major League Soccer.

Maximilian "Max" Michael Arfsten (born April 19, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club Middlesbrough, and the United States national team. Arfsten attended San Joaquin Memorial High School. In 2016, he posted 21 goals, 11 assists and earned all-league first team honors.
Mohamed Farsi (born 16 December 1999) is a Canadian professional soccer player who currently plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew.
Nariman Ahmad oğlu Akhundzade (born 23 April 2004) is an Azerbaijani professional footballer who plays as a winger for Columbus Crew of Major League Soccer and the Azerbaijan national team.
Nicholas George Hagen Godoy (born 2 August 1996) is a Guatemalan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew and the Guatemala national team.
Patrick Schulte (born March 13, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Columbus Crew in Major League Soccer.
Rudy Adrien Camacho (born 5 March 1991) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew.

Santiago Mariano Rodríguez Molina (born 8 January 2000) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo. Career On 3 November 2020, Montevideo City confirmed they had signed Rodríguez, with the midfielder remaining at Nacional for the rest of the year.
Sean Zawadzki (born April 21, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who currently plays for Major League Soccer side Columbus Crew .
Sekou Tidiany Bangoura (born 25 April 2002) is a Guinean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew and the Guinea national team.

Steven Moreira (born 13 August 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for Columbus Crew in Major League Soccer. Born in France, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Taha Habroune (born February 5, 2006) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew.

Wessam Haitham Mohammed Abou Ali (born 4 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew. Born in Denmark, he represents the Palestine national team.
